Priya: quick huddle on recurring kv-eviction patterns. want short, actionable items only. 1-line cause, 1-line mitigation, blockers.

Sam: cause: shard hot keys + TTL skew. mitigation: bump hot-shard limits and add short-term throttles for background tasks.

Rob: cause seen after shard-remap deploys. mitigation: add predeploy shard-remap canary + CI stress. blocker: CI resources.

Nina: tracker: #412 is the canonical ticket. current blocker = infra slot for migration + QA signoff.

Priya: proposed tiny action list (please ack or modify):
- A1: bump shard cache limit by 20% (owner: Sam, ETA: 2026-04-06)
- A2: add circuit-breaker for background traffic when evictions spike (owner: Sam, ETA: 2026-04-14)
- A3: CI shard-remap stress test (owner: Rob, ETA: 2026-04-10)
- A4: book infra migration slot (owner: Nina, ETA: 2026-04-08)

Sam: ack A1/A2. will draft config PR.

Rob: ack A3. will spike on CI test tomorrow.

Nina: ack A4. ops slot requested; pending confirmation. adding acceptance criteria to #412.

incident-bot: summary 2026-03-01..2026-03-31: 19 kv-eviction incidents, median MTTR 15m, primary labels: shard-hotness(47%), config-regression(21%), post-deploy-pressure(18%).

Priya: last items: Sam, please add design sketch to #412 by EOD Friday. Rob/Nina, update CI/ops status in #412 too. I'll run a 20-min retro in 1 week to check recurrence trend.

Sam: will do.

Rob: will update after spike.

Nina: will post ops slot confirmation when available.

Priya: thanks all. small, fast changes only for this round. :thumbsup:
